_doc: Localised strings for the composed advert. Each problem line becomes its own text card; solution is one card; cta is the end card. Keyed by the --locale value passed to record.py and compose.py.

_doc_android: The Android edition (compose.py --platform android) uses solution_android and cta_android in place of solution and cta: Android has no Apple Maps, so the claim is that the places go to the map app on the phone, and the store is Google Play. 'The map app' follows each language's own wording of emptyBodyAndroid in lib/l10n, so the advert and the app say it the same way. The problem lines are shared.
